errors.INVALID_EVENT_ENVELOPE: The captured event format is invalid. Contact support.
errors.UNTAGGED_TRANSACTION: The event is missing required business tags.
errors.STREAM_CONFLICT: This event conflicts with the latest central state.
errors.CALIBRATION_LOCKOUT: The referenced instrument is locked by calibration status.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough available stock at that location for this allocation.
errors.LOT_EXPIRED: The selected lot has expired and cannot be issued without an override.
errors.LOT_ON_HOLD: The selected lot is on quality hold and cannot be issued.
errors.JOBWORK_LOSS_REASON_CODE_INVALID: That process-loss reason code is not one of the codes configured for job work.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested record was not found.
errors.CUSTODY_NOT_ZERO: This job-work order still holds customer material on its custody ledger and cannot be closed until the balance is reconciled to zero.
errors.OFFCUT_ELECTION_MISSING: This job-work order has no contractual offcut arrangement, so no offcut can be captured for it.
errors.BILLING_NOT_READY: This job-work order is not ready to bill: it needs at least one dispatch.
errors.OFFCUT_NOT_RETAINED: This contractual offcut has already been disposed of and cannot be disposed of again.
errors.CREDIT_NOTE_MISSING: This offcut acquisition raised no credit note, so there is no document to revalue.
errors.CREDIT_NOTE_UNCITABLE: The service invoice for this order has not been acknowledged by ERP, so an offcut credit note has no document reference to cite.
errors.CREDIT_NOTE_SUPERSEDED: This offcut credit note has been superseded by a revaluation delta and is no longer the current document: it cannot be acknowledged, and a revaluation proposal priced against it can no longer be approved.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: The same person cannot generate or settle this record and also acknowledge the document that bills it.
errors.DUPLICATE_LOT: This lot already exists in the system.
errors.DUPLICATE_SERIAL: This serial number already exists in the system for this item.
errors.SERIAL_REQUIRED: This item requires serial numbers to be specified.
errors.SERIAL_NOT_ALLOWED: This item is not configured for serial-number capture.
errors.SERIAL_NOT_AVAILABLE: The selected serial number is not available at this location or lot.
errors.NO_AVAILABLE_LOT: No lot is available for selection with the requested quantity.
errors.LOT_NOT_FOUND: The specified lot was not found in the system.
errors.LOT_REQUIRED: This item is lot-controlled and requires a lot to be specified.
errors.SERIAL_NOT_FOUND: One or more serial numbers were not found in the system.
errors.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: The specified item was not found in the system.
errors.FUNCTION_ACCESS_DENIED: You are not authorized to perform this action.
errors.LOCATION_ACCESS_DENIED: This device is not authorized for that site.
errors.VALUATION_METHOD_NOT_PERMITTED: That valuation method is not permitted for this item.
errors.NRV_RECOVERY_EXCEEDS_ORIGINAL_COS: This recovery would carry the item above its original cost and cannot be recorded.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This action requires approval from the resolved approver before it can proceed.
errors.QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_APPROVED: The requested quantity exceeds the approved amount.
errors.LOT_MISMATCH: The received lot does not match the shipped lot.
errors.LOT_SKU_MISMATCH: That lot does not belong to the selected item.
errors.SERIAL_MISMATCH: The serials do not match the transfer request.
errors.APPROVAL_UNRESOLVED: No active approver could be resolved for this requisition. Contact an administrator.
errors.COUNT_TASK_LOCKED: This cycle count has already been submitted and cannot be changed.
errors.COUNT_ENTERER_CANNOT_APPROVE: The person who entered the count cannot approve its adjustment.
errors.PERIOD_LOCKED: This period is locked; the verification record can no longer be changed.
errors.COUNT_VARIANCE_REQUIRES_APPROVAL: This count variance requires approval before it can be adjusted.
errors.STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_NEGATIVE_BALANCE: This adjustment would drive stock below zero or below reserved quantity.
errors.OFFCUT_ADJUSTMENT_REFUSED: Offcut-class quantity is corrected through the offcut disposal and revaluation flow, not through a cycle count.
errors.LEAD_TIME_NOT_CONFIGURED: A lead time must be set for this item and location before safety stock can be computed.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_DEMAND_HISTORY: There is not enough demand history to compute safety stock for this item yet.
errors.INVALID_SERVICE_LEVEL: That service level is not supported. Choose 90%, 95%, 97.5%, or 99%.
errors.PLANNING_PARAMS_NOT_FOUND: No planning parameters are configured for this item and location.
errors.OBSOLESCENCE_THRESHOLD_NOT_CONFIG: An obsolescence threshold must be set before this item can be scanned for aging.
errors.OWNERSHIP_AGREEMENT_NOT_FOUND: No active consignment or VMI agreement exists for this item at this location.
errors.OWNER_PARTY_MISMATCH: The supplier on this receipt does not match the active ownership agreement.
errors.VMI_MIN_NOT_CONFIGURED: A VMI minimum quantity must be set on the agreement before the VMI check can run.
errors.INVALID_SIGNAL_TYPE: That replenishment signal type is not supported.
errors.SOURCE_SYSTEM_READ_ONLY: This record is owned by the ERP and is read-only here. Make corrections in the ERP; they arrive on the next sync.
errors.GATE_VEHICLE_REG_REQUIRED: Vehicle registration is required before gate capture can sync.
errors.GATE_CHALLAN_PHOTO_REQUIRED: A challan photo is required before gate capture can sync.
errors.GATE_PO_REF_REQUIRED: Scan or enter a PO reference, or use UNKNOWN when no PO is available.
errors.GATE_SITE_NOT_FOUND: The gate site is not recognized. Refresh site data and try again.
errors.GATE_REVERSAL_REASON_REQUIRED: A reversal reason is required for gate-event reversal.
errors.GATE_EVENT_NOT_FOUND: The gate event to reverse was not found centrally.
errors.GATE_ALREADY_REVERSED: This gate event was already reversed.
errors.WEIGHBRIDGE_TARE_REQUIRED: A tare weight is required before the weighment can sync.
errors.WEIGHBRIDGE_GROSS_REQUIRED: A gross weight is required before the weighment can sync.
errors.WEIGHBRIDGE_BINDING_TOKEN_REQUIRE: The vehicle-to-PO binding token is required for the weighment.
errors.WEIGHBRIDGE_BINDING_TOKEN_NOT_FOU: The binding token was not found centrally. Confirm the gate entry synced first.
errors.WEIGHBRIDGE_SITE_MISMATCH: The weighbridge site differs from the gate-entry site for this vehicle.
errors.WEIGHBRIDGE_NET_NEGATIVE: Net weight cannot be negative; check the tare and gross readings.
errors.WEIGHBRIDGE_PO_LINE_NOT_FOUND: The PO line for this weighment was not found. Refresh PO data and try again.
errors.ITEM_PO_MISMATCH: That PO isn't here yet. Double-check the number or contact procurement.
errors.RECEIPT_TOLERANCE_EXCEEDED: Over-receipt: this quantity exceeds the PO tolerance. A supervisor has been notified.
errors.RECEIVING_BINDING_TOKEN_REQUIRED: The vehicle-to-PO binding token is required to receive goods.
errors.RECEIVING_BINDING_TOKEN_NOT_FOUND: The binding token was not found centrally. Confirm the weighment synced first.
errors.RECEIVING_WEIGHT_NOT_ACCEPTED: Receipt is blocked: the weighment is outside tolerance and awaiting review.
errors.RECEIVING_PO_NOT_FOUND: The referenced PO was not found. Refresh PO data and try again.
errors.RECEIVING_QTY_REQUIRED: A received quantity is required before this line can sync.
errors.RECEIVING_QC_HOLD_ZONE_NOT_FOUND: No QC-hold zone is configured for this site. Contact your supervisor.
errors.LOCATION_NOT_FOUND: The target location was not found or is not active. Confirm the location and try again.
errors.PUTAWAY_TASK_NOT_FOUND: The putaway task was not found. Refresh and try again.
errors.PUTAWAY_TASK_NOT_HELD: This putaway task is no longer awaiting release.
errors.PICK_TASK_NOT_FOUND: The pick task was not found. Refresh and try again.
errors.PICK_LINE_NOT_FOUND: The pick line was not found. Refresh and try again.
errors.PICK_TASK_INVALID_PAYLOAD: The pick task data is incomplete. Contact your supervisor.
errors.PICK_LINE_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: This pick line was already confirmed with a different lot or quantity.
errors.PICK_OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED: A different lot was scanned. Enter an override reason to substitute.
errors.PICK_TASK_NOT_ALL_LINES_CONFIRMED: Confirm every pick line before completing this task.
errors.PICK_TASK_ALREADY_COMPLETED: This pick task is already completed. Refresh and try again.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK_FOR_PICK: Not enough available stock to cover this pick.
errors.DISPATCH_ORDER_LINE_NOT_FOUND: The dispatch order line was not found. Refresh and try again.
errors.PICK_QUANTITY_MISMATCH: Confirm the exact quantity shown on the pick line.
errors.PICK_TASK_ALREADY_GENERATED: Pick tasks already exist for this order line.
errors.DISPATCH_ORDER_NOT_PICKED: This order has not been fully picked yet. Complete picking first.
errors.DISPATCH_ORDER_NOT_PACKED: This order has not been packed yet. Complete packing first.
errors.DISPATCH_ORDER_ALREADY_DISPATCHED: This order has already been dispatched.
errors.DISPATCH_PACKED_INVALID_PAYLOAD: The packing data is incomplete. Check your inputs.
errors.DISPATCH_DOCUMENTS_INVALID_PAYLOA: The document generation request is incomplete. Check your inputs.
errors.DISPATCH_DISPATCHED_INVALID_PAYLO: The dispatch confirmation data is incomplete. Check your inputs.
errors.PACKED_QTY_MISMATCH: The packed quantity does not match the confirmed pick quantity.
errors.DISPATCH_DOCUMENTS_NOT_GENERATED: Shipping documents must be generated before dispatch.
errors.IRN_MISSING: This dispatch is blocked until its invoice IRN is recorded. Record the IRN, then retry dispatch.
errors.GST_DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED: This inter-branch transfer cannot ship until its GST documents are recorded. Ask the GST officer to record the tax invoice (with IRN) and, where required, the e-way bill.
errors.SITE_GSTIN_MISSING: One of the sites on this transfer has no GSTIN registration effective today. Ask the GST officer to register it before creating the transfer.
errors.VALUATION_CONFIG_MISSING: No branch transfer valuation basis is configured for this pair of GSTINs today. Ask the GST officer to configure it before creating the transfer.
errors.SHIP_QUANTITY_MISMATCH: Ship the exact quantity this transfer was valued and invoiced on. The tax invoice is already filed with a minted IRN, so the goods must match the document. To send a different quantity, ask the GST officer to cancel the tax invoice and re-raise it for the quantity you are shipping.
errors.VALUATION_BASIS_NOT_PERMITTED: The open market value and like kind and quality bases take a hand-declared unit value, so only the GST officer may create a transfer valued on them. Ask the GST officer to create it.
errors.DECLARED_VALUE_REQUIRED: This valuation basis is priced on a hand-declared unit value, and none was entered. Enter the declared unit value, or ask the GST officer to create the transfer.
errors.VALUATION_COST_UNAVAILABLE: This transfer cannot be valued because no cost is available for the item at the sending site. Ask finance to post the item cost, then create the transfer again.
errors.BASIS_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The valuation basis asked for cannot be used on this transfer. Ask the GST officer to configure an eligible basis for this pair of GSTINs.
errors.VALUATION_LOCKED: This transfer already has its GST documents recorded or has already shipped, so its valuation can no longer be changed. To value it differently, ask the GST officer to cancel the tax invoice and re-raise it.
errors.NOT_A_BRANCH_TRANSFER: This transfer is not an inter-GSTIN supply, so it has no branch transfer valuation to act on.
errors.GST_DOCUMENT_CONFLICT: GST documents are already recorded for this transfer with different details. Check the tax invoice number, and ask the GST officer to correct the recorded documents.
errors.GST_DOCUMENT_STATE_INVALID: GST documents can no longer be recorded for this transfer at its current stage - it has already moved past shipping. Ask the GST officer how to proceed.
errors.TRANSFER_SITE_MISMATCH: The site on this request is not the site this transfer belongs to. Switch to the transfer's own site and try again.
errors.GSTIN_CONFIG_OVERLAP: This GSTIN registration overlaps a registration that already exists for the site. Ask the GST officer to close the existing registration before adding a new one.
errors.VALUATION_CONFIG_OVERLAP: This valuation configuration overlaps a configuration that already exists for the same pair of GSTINs. Ask the GST officer to close the existing one before adding a new one.
errors.DISPATCH_IRN_CONFLICT: This dispatch order is already covered by a different invoice. Check the invoice number.
errors.DISPATCH_IRN_NOT_RECORDED: No IRN has been recorded for this dispatch order yet.
errors.DISPATCH_IRN_INVALID_PAYLOAD: The IRN recording is incomplete or malformed. The IRN must be the 64-character IRP hash.
errors.DISPATCH_ORDER_SITE_MISMATCH: One of the listed dispatch orders belongs to a different site.
errors.DISPATCH_ORDER_CLOSED: This sales order line is closed in ERP; an IRN cannot be recorded against it.
errors.ASN_PO_NOT_FOUND: The PO referenced by this ASN was not found. Refresh PO data and try again.
crossDock.title: Confirm known cross-dock task
crossDock.description: Enter a known task ID, review its receipt and staging context, then scan the staging bin.
crossDock.pendingResult: Staging confirmation captured and pending sync.
crossDock.nextAction: Keep the item in the scanned staging bin until sync completes, then continue with the next task.
crossDock.loadError: The known task could not be loaded. Check the task ID and connection, then retry.
crossDock.correction: Correct the task or staging-bin scan and submit again.
errors.INVALID_PARAMS: Check the task ID and staging-bin scan, correct them, and try again.
errors.CROSS_DOCK_TASK_NOT_FOUND: This cross-dock task was not found. Check the task ID or refresh it with a supervisor.
errors.CROSS_DOCK_TASK_NOT_READY: This cross-dock task is no longer ready. Refresh the task before continuing.
errors.CROSS_DOCK_TASK_ALREADY_COMPLETED: This task was already completed differently. Stop and ask a supervisor to verify the staging bin.
errors.CROSS_DOCK_STAGING_INVALID: The expected staging zone is invalid. Ask a supervisor to correct the task.
errors.CROSS_DOCK_DESTINATION_OUTSIDE_ST: Scan an active bin inside the expected staging zone.
errors.CROSS_DOCK_SITE_MISMATCH: This task belongs to a different site. Stop and contact a supervisor.
errors.CROSS_DOCK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN: The matched sales order is no longer open. Stop and contact a supervisor.
errors.CROSS_DOCK_DEMAND_ALREADY_ALLOCAT: The matched demand was allocated elsewhere. Stop and contact a supervisor.
errors.CROSS_DOCK_QUANTITY_MISMATCH: The receipt, lot, or task quantity no longer matches. Stop and contact a supervisor.
errors.DUPLICATE_SUPPLIER_GSTIN: A supplier with this GSTIN already exists. Check the supplier registry and try again.
errors.SUPPLIER_NOT_FOUND: The specified supplier was not found in the system.
errors.SUPPLIER_NOT_ACTIVE: Only active suppliers can be updated. Ensure the supplier is active first.
errors.SUPPLIER_ALREADY_ACTIVE: This supplier is already active and does not require onboarding.
errors.SUPPLIER_ALREADY_APPROVED: This supplier has already been approved.
errors.SUPPLIER_ONBOARDING_NOT_SUBMITTED: Onboarding has not been submitted for this supplier.
errors.SUPPLIER_NOT_IN_ONBOARDING: This supplier must be in onboarding status for this action.
errors.SUPPLIER_NOT_ACTIVE_OR_ONBOARDING: Only active or onboarding suppliers can be deactivated.
errors.IMMUTABLE_FIELD: Cannot modify immutable fields on this supplier record.
errors.INDENT_NOT_FOUND: The specified requisition was not found in the system.
errors.INDENT_ALREADY_DECIDED: This requisition has already been approved or rejected.
errors.INDENT_NOT_IN_RAISED: This requisition is not in a status that allows this action.
errors.INDENT_RAISER_CANNOT_APPROVE: You cannot approve or reject your own requisition.
errors.NOT_RESOLVED_APPROVER: Only the resolved approving authority can decide this requisition.
errors.INDENT_REJECTION_REASON_REQUIRED: A rejection reason is required to reject a requisition.
errors.INDENT_PENDING_CONFIRMATION: This requisition is held as a possible duplicate. Confirm or withdraw it first.
errors.INDENT_LINE_REQUIRED: A requisition needs at least one line item.
errors.CENTRAL_ONLY_OPERATION: This action must be done centrally, not from this device.
errors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: The work order cannot move to that status from its current status.
errors.WORK_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: The work order was not found centrally. Refresh the worklist.
errors.WORK_ORDER_ALREADY_COMPLETED: The work order was already completed centrally.
errors.WORK_ORDER_DERIVATION_MISMATCH: The work order details do not match the central record.
errors.CLOSURE_CODES_REQUIRED: Fault, cause and remedy codes are required to close this work order.
errors.CLOSURE_CODE_INVALID: One of the closure codes is not in the configured catalogue.
errors.ASSET_NOT_FOUND: No asset matches the scanned tag.
errors.ASSET_TAG_MISMATCH: The scanned tag does not match the asset on record.
errors.METER_NOT_FOUND: The meter was not found centrally. Refresh the worklist.
errors.METER_READING_REGRESSION: The reading is lower than the last recorded reading.
errors.RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND: The spare reservation was not found centrally.
errors.RESERVATION_NOT_RESERVED: The spare reservation is no longer in the reserved state.
errors.SPARE_DERIVATION_MISMATCH: The issued quantity does not match the reservation.
errors.COST_DERIVATION_MISMATCH: The closure details do not match the central work order.
errors.INVALID_PAYLOAD: The captured details are incomplete or malformed.
errors.QC_TASK_NOT_FOUND: The inspection task was not found centrally. Refresh the task list.
errors.QC_SAMPLING_REQUIRED: Sampling has not been determined for this task yet. Determine sampling centrally first.
errors.QC_TASK_NOT_OPEN_FOR_RESULTS: Inspection of this task is already complete. No further results are accepted.
errors.QC_CHARACTERISTIC_NOT_IN_PLAN: The characteristic is not part of the inspection plan frozen on this task.
errors.QC_SAMPLE_UNIT_OUT_OF_RANGE: The sample unit number is outside the range this characteristic requires.
errors.QC_RESULT_KIND_MISMATCH: The result type does not match the characteristic (numeric measurement or attribute).
errors.QC_RESULT_UOM_MISMATCH: The unit of measure does not match the characteristic limits.
errors.QC_RESULT_EXISTS: A result already exists for this characteristic and sample unit.
errors.INSTRUMENT_NOT_FOUND: The asset is not a registered measuring instrument.
errors.INSTRUMENT_NOT_PERMITTED: This characteristic is recorded by observation, not with an instrument.
errors.QC_DERIVATION_MISMATCH: The captured result details do not match the central inspection record.
indent.title: Raise purchase requisition
indent.description: Enter the item, quantity, and need-by date. The requisition is captured locally and syncs when connected.
indent.nextAction: Your requisition will sync and route for approval when connected. You will be notified on every decision.
indent.correction: Correct the highlighted fields and submit again.
maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Technician work orders cached for offline capture. Captures sync when connected.
maintenance.worklist.title: Work orders
maintenance.worklist.empty: No work orders cached on this device. Connect to refresh.
maintenance.worklist.truncated: more work orders not loaded, connect to refresh
maintenance.closures.title: Last five closures
maintenance.closures.empty: No recorded closures for this asset.
maintenance.fault.title: Report a fault
maintenance.fault.description: Scan the asset tag and describe the fault.
maintenance.fault.assetTagHint: Scan or type the asset tag
maintenance.fault.nextAction: The fault will reach the supervisor when connected.
maintenance.fault.correction: Enter the asset tag and a description, then submit again.
maintenance.status.title: Update work order status
maintenance.status.nextAction: The status will sync when connected.
maintenance.status.correction: Choose a status, then submit again.
maintenance.meter.title: Record a meter reading
maintenance.meter.nextAction: The reading will sync when connected.
maintenance.meter.correction: Choose a meter and enter a numeric reading, then submit again.
maintenance.meter.empty: No meters are registered for this asset.

maintenance.spare.nextAction: The issue will sync when connected; the return clock is set centrally.
maintenance.spare.correction: Choose a reserved spare, then submit again.
maintenance.spare.empty: No reserved spares are cached for this work order.
maintenance.closure.title: Close work order
maintenance.closure.description: All three closure codes are required.
maintenance.closure.nextAction: The closure will sync when connected.
maintenance.closure.correction: Choose a fault, cause and remedy code, then submit again.
maintenance.unavailable: Sign in and connect once before maintenance capture is available.
errors.ORDER_CLOSED: This production order is closed and can no longer be changed.
errors.CLOSURE_GATE_BLOCKED: This production order cannot be closed yet: open WIP, staged material or an uninspected output lot remains.
errors.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: That production order no longer exists on the server.
errors.PRODUCTION_ORDER_DERIVATION_MISMA: The production order changed on the server since this was captured.
errors.PRODUCTION_MATERIAL_DERIVATION_MI: The material details changed on the server since this was captured.
errors.PRODUCTION_COMPLETION_DERIVATION_: The completion details changed on the server since this was captured.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: That change is not allowed from the current state.
errors.UNREVERSED_TRANSACTIONS: Material issued against this order must be returned or reversed first.
errors.BOM_REVISION_DRIFT: The bill of materials changed since this order was released. Ask a planner to re-release it.
errors.MATERIAL_REQUIREMENT_SET_TRUNCATE: The bill of materials is too deep to explode completely. Contact engineering.
errors.STAGE_NOT_FOUND: That staged material line no longer exists on the server.
errors.STAGE_ALREADY_ISSUED: That staged material line has already been issued in full.
errors.RETURN_EXCEEDS_ISSUE: You cannot return more than was issued to this order.
errors.REASON_CODE_REQUIRED: Choose a reason code before submitting.
errors.WIP_COST_UNRESOLVED: This component has no costed valuation yet, so it cannot be issued.
errors.QC_HOLD_REQUIRED: Finished output must post into QC Hold, never straight to sellable stock.
errors.PROTOTYPE_NOT_SALEABLE: This item is a prototype and can never be sold or dispatched as sellable stock.
errors.KIT_LINE_MISMATCH: This consumption does not match a kit line on the order's current revision. Check the order revision with the office.
errors.OFFCUT_ELECTION_MISSING: This order has no contractual offcut arrangement, so offcut cannot be captured against it. Ask the office to record the election first.
errors.BILLING_NOT_READY: This order cannot be billed yet - its price basis or preconditions are missing. An office action, not a retry.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: The same person cannot both post and approve this action. Ask a different authorised person to complete it.
errors.OFFCUT_NOT_RETAINED: This offcut holding is no longer retained, so it cannot be disposed of again.
errors.CREDIT_NOTE_MISSING: No acknowledged service invoice exists to cite for this acquisition. An office action, not a retry.
errors.CREDIT_NOTE_UNCITABLE: The credit note cited does not belong to this order's service invoice. Check the reference with the office.
errors.CREDIT_NOTE_SUPERSEDED: This credit note has been superseded by a revaluation; the current document carries the value. Re-post against the latest document.
